selectionRule: Prioritize fresh demand, low fulfillment complexity, and shorter legitimate time-to-sale when an existing PrismBay Clean SKU already has mapped store infrastructure. Existing store presence never waives supplier identity, stock, exact freight, rights, checkout, or unit-economics verification.

candidates.name: Crevice Cleaning Brush Set
queries: stiff bristle gap cleaning brush set
candidates.searchStrategy: prefer compact multi-piece stiff-bristle set matching PrismBay intended product identity; reject unrelated bottle brushes, power brushes, drill brushes and generic cleaning kits

candidates.name: Drain Hair Catcher and Strainer
